title: Daily Rate Applied When Reducing a Medicare Part A Resident Charge for Reversed Days
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — the rate the charge stands at.** The daily rate the reduction for reversed covered days applies is the rate the charge stands at: when the records carry a rate-year correction against the charge and the lapse's block has its last service date in 2025, 209.50 a day; when they carry one and that date falls in 2024, 204.00 a day; when they carry one and that date falls in 2026 or later, 217.00 a day; and otherwise the daily rate the charge records.

The lapse is the uncertified-day reversal posted against the booked-days entry of the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block after the resident's original coinsurance charge for that block was posted; the lapse's block is that block. A rate-year correction against the charge is an adjustment with the reason rate-year correction naming that resident charge in the episode's Medicare billing history.

| Rate-year correction against the charge | Last service date of the lapse's block | Daily rate of the reduction for reversed covered days |
|---|---|---|
| On record | In 2025 | 209.50 |
| On record | In 2024 | 204.00 |
| On record | In 2026 or later | 217.00 |
| Otherwise | — | The daily rate the charge records |

*Hypothetical worked example:* a resident's charge records 209.50 a day for a block whose last service date falls in 2024, and a rate-year correction against it is on record. Four reversed days at a resident share of 100 percent are priced at 204.00 each: 816.00. Without the correction on record, the same four days would be priced at the recorded 209.50.
